dispositions.rationale: Independently verified against main e807e713 and the candidate files. The one shared original is Excalibur (1988) #100 (issueId 8564, digitalId 11019), with identical issueId and digitalId values in both lists, at Onslaught position 46 and Nightcrawler position 116. An independent intersection of the two payloads is exactly this one, and neither list contains the other, so partial is correct. Onslaught's identities, positions and placeholders are unchanged; both lists keep the shared original as one shared read identity.
